Omar N: Quick Q  took an overnight rail leg (company event) and my corporate card wouldn't process the sleeper cabin so I paid on personal. Also vendor handed me a paper VAT receipt and said stamp at customs is optional on domestic rail. How to submit?
Priya (People Ops): Thanks for flagging. Upload the itemized rail receipt and boarding confirmation. For VAT receipts that are not stamped, upload as-is and mark as 'VAT pending'. Finance will reconcile if a refund is later issued.
Omar N: The hotel folio has both room and a minibar charge. Minibar is personal. How to split on one folio?
Finance Ops Bot: Submit the full folio and add line-item notes in the expense form: mark minibar as "Non-reimbursable" and set payment type for room = Personal Card (reimburse). If you have a separate card transaction showing only the room charge that helps but not required.
Eve L: What if I only have a handwritten carnet from the conductor for the rail? It's dated but not an official invoice.
Priya (People Ops): Handwritten conductor notes under €15 can be attested with manager approval. Use the taxi template style but for rail: date, route, amount, conductor note, manager sign-off.
Omar N: Any naming convention? Also receipts are older than 45 days.
Priya (People Ops): Naming: YYYYMMDD_vendor_purpose_amount (e.g., 20261012_InterCity_sleep_120EUR). If >60 days old it's an exception; at 45 days you're fine. If you expect delays, ping @Finance Ops early.
Finance Ops Bot: Reminder: for mixed personal/company charges on one folio, include a short screenshot of your card transaction showing the reimbursed amount if possible.
Omar N: Great, thanks. I'll upload and tag @Priya for quick pre-check.
Priya (People Ops): Happy to review before you submit.
